dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: How can I save enough money to buy a custom-made axe with floral carvings from the blacksmith's shop...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need that for?

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: To use as a weapon, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: I might just be a homemaker right now, but I used to be a mercenary with the Eremites, so I always feel uneasy without a weapon at home.

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: Peace is precious, but you must always be prepared for the worst.

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: See you. Whether you're out or at home, make sure you stay safe.

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only my useless husband could think like you...

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: The more money he makes, the more bows and arrows I can buy to keep my house safe. After all, the storage and maintenance of weapons are very important.
